summary: Frontend-only re-verification of the web barcode scanner fix (/app/frontend/app/scan.web.tsx). ALL PASS. Login (abdul/Salam@123) succeeded. SEARCH -> /scan?mode=search&company=All renders WITHOUT crash: document.querySelectorAll('video').length === 1, and video attributes { autoPlay:true, muted:true, playsInline:true, hasStream(srcObject):true, 390x614 } — ZXing BrowserMultiFormatReader.decodeFromConstraints successfully mounted a live <video> node via react-native-web unstable_createElement. Targeting bracket + Gujarati hint 'Barcode/QR ને bracket માં clear રાખો — auto scan થશે' visible, MANUAL PART NUMBER label + input + 'SEARCH — Continue' button all rendered. Manual entry: filled 'TEST-WEB-123' + tapped Continue -> navigated to /part/TEST-WEB-123 showing 'NEW PART' badge, 'PART NUMBER TEST-WEB-123', and AI Research (Gemini) card with 'Run AI Research' button. REQUIREMENT mode: video count=1, continue label='REQUIREMENT — Continue', manual input visible. Console shows only expected benign ZXing NotFound/Format/Checksum warnings (decoder loop trying every codec against the empty headless fake camera stream — that is normal decoder behavior, no user-facing error, no red screen).
action_items: Optional (cosmetic): ZXing prints per-frame decoder exceptions to console.warn. To silence, wrap decodeFromConstraints callback error path or filter reader hints — non-blocking.
critical_code_review_comments: scan.web.tsx correctly uses react-native-web unstable_createElement to render a real HTML <video>, then attaches ZXing BrowserMultiFormatReader via decodeFromConstraints({video:{facingMode:'environment'}}) — the standard, correct pattern for web camera barcode scanning.
Cleanup is proper: controlsRef.current?.stop?.() is called on unmount and after a successful decode via proceed().
doneRef guards against double navigation if the decoder callback fires multiple times before controls.stop() takes effect — good.
Three status states (init/ready/denied/error) with tailored Gujarati hint text; permission-denied fallback shows a bar with a Settings button while keeping manual entry usable — good UX.
Native scan.tsx (expo-camera) is untouched, so device/APK path is unaffected.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Web scanner fix verified end-to-end. testIDs used: login-username, login-password, login-submit, module-search/buy/sell/requirement, manual-part-input, scan-continue. Real barcode decoding cannot be exercised in headless (no real camera pointed at a code) — that limitation is acknowledged in the review request and does not affect PASS criteria.
